specs.title: PROD-B01 @baseline drawing width affects exported ink and reload
PROD-B02 @baseline stroke eraser removes only the hit stroke and history restores it
PROD-B03 @baseline partial erase persists a targeted mask and later ink survives
PROD-B04 @baseline P E and history shortcuts perform their advertised operations
PROD-B05 @baseline legacy JSON import/export preserves geometry masks and exact explicit blue
PROD-B06 @baseline malformed and unsupported imports cannot overwrite the saved notebook
PROD-B07 @baseline Help toggle and home navigation preserve the notebook
PROD-B08 @baseline DPR resize preserves exported geometry and rapid endpoint
PROD-B09 @baseline real worker computes then equals erase retires answer and undo restores it
PROD-B10 @baseline cached offline reload allows real inference editing and saving
PROD-B11 @baseline real model load failure keeps drawing and Retry recovers
PROD-B12 @baseline Clear is undoable and history disabled states are truthful
PROD-B13 @baseline visible controls are declared in the action registry
PROD-B14 @baseline projection renderer failure keeps ink export and useful notice
PROD-D01 @baseline active replay alpha parity and long-stroke frame samples
PROD-D02 @baseline recognition never blanks existing ink or resets unchanged projection dimensions
PROD-D03 @baseline layout waste and breakpoint availability observation
PROD-N01 Hand camera controls preserve world ink revision and zoom anchor with fitted bounds
PROD-N02 transformed drawing and pixel erase export exact world points masks and reversible geometry
PROD-N03 trusted two-touch promotion discards pen and erase previews and pinch pan adds no history
PROD-N04 trusted pointer cancellation retains ordinary samples and releases camera lock
PROD-N05 controlled window blur restores ordinary Pen after Space pan without phantom strokes or camera history
PROD-N06 actual model projection follows pan and anchored zoom without document revisions
PROD-N07 wheel pan and Control wheel retain anchored world position and document revision
PROD-N08 trusted pen and eraser gestures survive secondary two-touch navigation attempts
